title: Manpower U.S. Recognized as a Star Performer and Leader in Three Everest Group U.S. Contingent Talent and Strategic Solutions PEAK Matrix® Assessments 2026
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about ManpowerGroup Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
MILWAUKEE


, Sept. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Manpower has been named a Star Performer and Leader across three Everest Group U.S. Contingent Talent and Strategic Solutions PEAK Matrix® assessments for 2026. The Star Performer distinction is awarded to organizations demonstrating the most significant year-over-year improvements in market success and capability advancement. Together, these recognitions demonstrate market leadership, ongoing innovation and a continued commitment to delivering workforce solutions that help clients meet evolving talent needs.


Manpower earned Leader and Star Performer designations in three assessment categories:


- **Industrial**
- **Engineering**
- **Business & Professional**


The assessments recognized[Manpower](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780523-1&h=2124814725&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.manpower.com%2Fen%2Finsights%2Fblogs%2Fmanpower-receives-accolades-from-everest-group%3Futm_source%3Dpublic-relations%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_campaign%3Dmp_us_b2b_everest-award_2026&a=Manpower) for its specialized talent expertise, workforce solutions innovation and strategic investments in technology and managed services. Everest Group also highlighted the company's growing strengths in workforce transformation, skills development and talent delivery across high-demand sectors.


"Manpower has further strengthened its position on Everest Group's U.S. Industrial Contingent Talent and Strategic Solutions PEAK Matrix® assessment 2026, emerging as a Leader and Star Performer due to its significant market impact and capability expansion," said Priyanka Mitra, Vice President of Everest Group.


Everest Group cited continued expansion of onsite and outsourced workforce solutions, investments in AI-powered workforce intelligence and a commitment to skills development as key factors contributing to the recognition.


"Being recognized as a Star Performer across three Everest Group PEAK Matrix® assessments demonstrates the breadth of our workforce solutions portfolio," Rajesh Namboothiry, Senior Vice President of Manpower North America, said. "Organizations need a workforce that can evolve and adapt to new and unexpected challenges. This recognition reflects our ability to help organizations successfully meet those challenges with specialized talent expertise, skills development and workforce solutions designed for what's next."


Everest Group's PEAK Matrix® assessment is an annual evaluation of contingent staffing providers' market success and delivery capability. It considers factors including market adoption, value delivered, breadth of services, innovation and investments, delivery footprint and overall strategy. Based on this evaluation, providers are positioned as Leaders, Major Contenders, or Aspirants.
